title: Police tenant verification, thane aana hai

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Namaste, main Sector 21 police chowki se Head Constable Yadav bol raha hoon. Aapke makaan maalik ne tenant verification form diya hai.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Haan ji, humne form bhara tha.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Kal subah gyarah baje chowki aa jaiye, Aadhaar aur rent agreement ki copy le aaiye. Bas signature aur photo lena hai.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Iski koi fees nahi hai. Phone pe hum kabhi paise nahi maangte.
